platforms.name: cursor
platforms.notes: Rules must be fully inlined in .mdc files. Cannot follow file references. Use ALWAYS/NEVER/CRITICAL keywords. Break into small focused files. Valid YAML frontmatter required or silently ignored.

platforms.name: windsurf
platforms.notes: Same format as .cursorrules. Single flat file with all rules inlined.

platforms.name: github-copilot
platforms.notes: Repo-wide copilot-instructions.md (Tier 3 style) PLUS path-scoped .github/instructions/NAME.instructions.md files with an `applyTo` glob frontmatter field (comma-separated patterns, e.g. `applyTo: "**/*.go"` — not an array like Cursor's globs). Both coexist and combine per GitHub's own docs. Upgraded from Tier 3 to Tier 2 (2026-07) after confirming this via official docs: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/configure-custom-instructions-in-your-ide/add-repository-instructions-in-your-ide

platforms.name: gemini
platforms.installStrategy: generate-inline for AGENTS.md, symlink for skills (project or global depending on install mode)
platforms.notes: FULLY CONFIRMED 2026-07-02 via tests/platform-verification/antigravity.md, Tests 1-5 (Antigravity v2.1.1): AGENTS.md is read and injected as `<RULE[AGENTS.md]>` in the system prompt — matched shared/rules/approval-gates.md exactly. The previously-generated .gemini/antigravity/instructions.md is CONFIRMED NOT READ — removed entirely. Skills are genuinely invoked, not described — down to quoting a specific skill file's own example threshold (complexity-check.md's `gocyclo -over 6`) and writing to that same skill's exact specified output path (.claude/feature-workspace/complexity-report.md), not generic behavior. Both scopes confirmed: global root (~/.gemini/config/skills/, exercised first when .agents/skills/ didn't exist yet) and project-level (.agents/skills/, confirmed from a fresh --project install with the directory present before session start — Test 5). Antigravity appears to merge project-level skills with an unrelated global/built-in skill set (Firebase, Chrome DevTools, bioinformatics tools were also listed — none of those exist in shared/skills/). .agents/rules/ specifically remains unexercised (AGENTS.md already carries that content, so it may be redundant) — not contradicted either. subAgentOrchestration/hooks remain unconfirmed — no evidence for or against.
